components.content_intent: Open with the windowsill plant and surface the soil-food idea without resolving it yet.
State that photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose; exclude soil-as-food.
Define photosynthesis with inputs (light, water, CO2) and output (glucose + oxygen).
Walk the windowsill plant through light → chlorophyll → glucose, contrasting soil nutrients vs food energy.
Prompt learners to explain energy conversion for a shaded vs sunny plant without inventing new science.
Ask one check that forces a choice between soil-food and light-to-glucose conversion.
